name: M7 Remote hosts
intro: --host, Lavish through SSH port forwarding, plain ssh -t host asmai, and the virtual machine for S9. The milestone table and the accepted documents settle it, so there is no question; review it and accept or annotate. When you accept it I commit it and start M8 Release and upgrade.
notes: The virtual machine is set up in M7, when S9's demo is about to run, as AssemblyAI#12 allowed (setting it up blocks nothing until then).
The demo includes the remote host's reboot, so the service is installed on the virtual machine; S9's evidence is S8's for the remote host plus the forwarded Lavish answer and the SSH drop.
